resolved_findings.finding: Recovery gate rows did not establish that OFF and NORMAL MODE followed probe exit.
resolved_findings.resolution: Timezone-aware timestamps require confirmed exit <= new user OFF <= new user NORMAL MODE, all matching the current session.

resolved_findings.finding: Gate state and abort could change during client inspection without being rechecked.
resolved_findings.resolution: Reload and revalidate current gates and execution after client inspection, before reservation; the injected abort-during-scan case fails before launching.

resolved_findings.finding: Qualification hashing and parsing used separate file reads, permitting misleading hash attribution.
resolved_findings.resolution: Read bytes once, hash and parse that same buffer, require unchanged hash after client inspection, and persist that validated hash in PREFLIGHT.

reviewed_behavior: Requires exactly one prior probe invocation, confirmed child exit, engine OFF and fresh NORMAL MODE recovery state.
Allows only fixed qualified passive BF/A8 capture with count120 and interval250ms; checks all retained passive input hashes.
Exclusive output directory and invocation marker prevent retries or evidence overwrite.
Checks clients before capture and after child exit. Shares reviewed wait-for-child lifecycle handling.
V2 mocked controls PASS14, including fresh chronology and abort arriving during the client scan; source and wrapper hashes match current files.
limits: The wrapper performs no RK03/RK02 kernel upload and grants no physical authorization.

A passive child exit alone does not prove OEM-return success; root must independently require BF2F12515306, expected acquisition, PASS_CAPTURE_ONLY and clean observer/broker/provider exit from produced evidence.
Output-directory reservation is consumed even if client inspection fails; no automatic retry.
Old component gates remain operator-managed under the current simplified ignition-state policy.
